blocks.text:
Notification Center puts a row of app icons above the list, one for every app with something waiting, and a red count on any app with more than one.

Tap an icon and the list narrows to that app; tap it again and everything comes back. The chosen icon lifts and the rest fade, so it is clear what you are looking at. The row only appears when two or more apps have notifications - with one there is nothing to choose between.

Like every tweak it has its own page in Settings › Tweaks, with a switch for the cover screen and a switch for the inner one, so it can be on where it helps and off where it doesn't.

Inspired by Axon by Nepeta. Re-created from scratch for Folio; no tweak code is included.

items: One icon for each app with notifications
Tap to see only that app, tap again for all
A count on an app with more than one
Hidden when only one app has anything

blocks.fallback: Without notification access Folio has no notifications to sort, so the row doesn't appear. Notification Center shows a button to allow access instead.

entries.notes: Roll Call becomes a package in the Folio Market. The tweak itself has shipped with Folio since 0.6.0.
